item.title: Performance testing guide
item.description: This guide helps you compare Speedle with other authorization engines on your own machine. It does not publish a performance report. Numbers depend on your hardware, your policy set and the engine versions you pin, so the result worth trusting is the one you measure yourself. The guide provides a shared scenario, equivalent policies for four engines, a methodology checklist and a prompt you can paste into an AI coding tool such as Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, DeepSeek Harness or a similar tool.
